knowledgeBlocks.sqlCode: INSERT INTO {CDM}.C_AGT_MICRO_CREDIT_COMPY_ACCT SELECT DATE '{ETL_TX_DT}', TA1.agent_pay_compy_acct_no, TA1.agent_pay_compy_name, TA1.corp_cust_no, TA1.org_no FROM (SELECT T01.agent_pay_compy_acct_no, T01.agent_pay_compy_name, CASE WHEN T03.main_cust_no IS NOT NULL THEN T03.main_cust_no WHEN T04.core_cust_no IS NOT NULL THEN T04.core_cust_no ELSE T01.agent_pay_compy_name END AS corp_cust_no, T01.org_no FROM {CDM}.C_AGT_MICRO_CREDIT_COMPY_ACCT_INIT T01 LEFT JOIN {FDM}.F_AC_CRBS_CUST_ACCT_NO T03 ON T01.agent_pay_compy_acct_no = T03.cust_acct_no AND T03.start_dt <= DATE '{ETL_TX_DT}' AND T03.end_dt > DATE '{ETL_TX_DT}' AND T03.del_flag <> 'D' LEFT JOIN (SELECT cust_name, core_cust_no, ROW_NUMBER()OVER(PARTITION BY cust_name ORDER BY last_update_tm DESC) t4rn FROM {FDM}.F_PT_ECIF_WHOLE_BANK_CUST_INF WHERE cust_type_cd = '2' AND start_dt <= DATE '{ETL_TX_DT}' AND end_dt > DATE '{ETL_TX_DT}' AND del_flag <> 'D') T04 ON T01.agent_pay_compy_name = T04.cust_name AND T04.t4rn = 1) TA1 GROUP BY TA1.agent_pay_compy_acct_no, TA1.agent_pay_compy_name, TA1.corp_cust_no, TA1.org_no

knowledgeBlocks.sqlCode: INSERT INTO {CDM}.C_AGT_MICRO_CREDIT_COMPY_ACCT SELECT DATE '{ETL_TX_DT}', TA1.agent_pay_compy_acct_no, TA1.agent_pay_compy_name, TA1.corp_cust_no, TA1.org_no FROM (SELECT T01.agent_pay_compy_acct_no, T01.agent_pay_compy_name, CASE WHEN T03.main_cust_no IS NOT NULL THEN T03.main_cust_no WHEN T04.core_cust_no IS NOT NULL THEN T04.core_cust_no ELSE T01.agent_pay_compy_name END AS corp_cust_no, T02.ORG_ID FROM {CDM}.C_TRN_MICRO_CREDIT_FLOWS T01 INNER JOIN (SELECT org_id, unit_cust_no, unit_name, ROW_NUMBER()OVER(PARTITION BY unit_name ORDER BY related_unit_cust_no DESC, related_unit_cust_name DESC, unit_cust_no DESC) t2rn FROM {CDM}.C_CUS_ENT_ADDIT_RECOR_INF WHERE data_dt = DATE '{ETL_TX_DT}' AND est_agent_pay_chan = '他行小额贷记' AND LENGTH(unit_name) > 3) T02 ON T01.agent_pay_compy_name = T02.unit_name AND T02.t2rn = 1 LEFT JOIN {FDM}.F_AC_CRBS_CUST_ACCT_NO T03 ON T01.agent_pay_compy_acct_no = T03.cust_acct_no AND T03.start_dt <= DATE '{ETL_TX_DT}' AND T03.end_dt > DATE '{ETL_TX_DT}' AND T03.del_flag <> 'D' LEFT JOIN (SELECT cust_name, core_cust_no, ROW_NUMBER()OVER(PARTITION BY cust_name ORDER BY last_update_tm DESC) t4rn FROM {FDM}.F_PT_ECIF_WHOLE_BANK_CUST_INF WHERE cust_type_cd = '2' AND start_dt <= DATE '{ETL_TX_DT}' AND end_dt > DATE '{ETL_TX_DT}' AND del_flag <> 'D') T04 ON T01.agent_pay_compy_name = T04.cust_name AND T04.t4rn = 1 WHERE T01.data_dt >= DATE '20230701' AND T01.data_dt <= DATE '{ETL_TX_DT}') TA1 GROUP BY TA1.agent_pay_compy_acct_no, TA1.agent_pay_compy_name, TA1.corp_cust_no, TA1.org_no
